title: Death and the Newlyweds
source_text:
K̇uró, omaṇṇux, ḥur, kәtwa zlām, dʕele lu+Alohayḏe, dʕele lu+Alohayḏe, dhowele abro. 
Hawile abro, hawile abro, hawi bāš, hawi bәlṭə́k, hawi ... sәmle ḥәkәm d̥šwaḥṣar+tmonaḥṣar+әšne. 
Omar, ‘Lawo, gәmṭenux ḥḏo’. 
Omar, ‘Baba, hat kuḏʕat, hat kuḏʕat, wăki  mṭay, hat kuḏʕat, sarbasthat. 
Ánnaqqa imane  layt, lә+gyome, lә+gmar lo+Ăḷah, lo+flān lo+behvān . 
Lә+ktowar u+xabro du+babayḏe.   
U+babayḏe omar, ‘Tәmā́m, oġlәm,  kṭolabnux ḥḏo’. 
Omar, ‘ṭlab!’ 
‘Dman ṭolabno?...’ 
Omar, ‘Oġlәm, kәtle lu+baqòro, u+baqòro, kәtle ḥḏo+barṯo. 
I+barṯayḏe šafə́rtoyo ŭ ṭáwtoyo, híyaste lgorā́n díḏuxyo, lo+kәmdaglo ŭ lo+koyәmyo, lgorā́n diḏuxyo’.  
. Omar, ‘Tәmā́m’. 
Maḥatle u+nišanayḏe, naḥәtle u+maloxo, naḥәtle u+maloxo. 
Omar, ‘Dәmṭatlux ḥḏo’, omar, ‘Gmayṯat, dlә+mṭat ḥḏo ktowat yašamíš,  lә+gmayṯat xayifo’. 
Omar, ‘Tәmā́m’.  
. I+k̇ačk̇estene ʕayni xoṯe,  ŭ azzé u+maloxo si ... li+k̇ačk̇e, mәḷḷela li+k̇ačk̇e, omar, ‘D̥saymat ḥa gmayṯat, ŭ dlo+saymat, ktowat yašamíš’. 
Әmmo, ‘Tәmā́m, tәmā́m’. 
Hawxa madәmme,  madәmme hawxa. 
Qām maḥatte u+nišanaṯṯe mḥawlalle, mḥawlalle, aṯәn lu+bayto sәmme daʕwo ŭ nḥәrre săwā́l, ŭ sәmme baṣro ŭ rezo ŭ bәrġәl, sə́mmanne muklo, qralle lu+ʕulmo, u+muklo koxal u+ʕulmo. 
Hánostene ... kito ruʕyo, faqíroyo. 
Kәtle ḥḏo+qemәsto ele ŭ li+aṯto, ŭ kәtle arbʕo+naʕime, kәtle arbʕo+naʕime, ŭ kәtle ...  I+aṯto konәfqo kolawšo u+fistanayḏa,  ŭ hiye d̥konofaq konofaq, kolowaš u+fistān, latle ... faqiroyo ... latle mede.  
Ḥa+fistānyo. 
Da+tre, ḥa+fistānyo. 
Hánostene ... Qām li+ḥurmayḏe mәḷḷa lu+merk̇o, әmmo, ‘Mērk̇o!’ 
Omar, ‘Ha’. 
Әmmo, ‘Mērk̇o, de hăma  zux, mbal i+ṣәṭlo, mṭaylan әšmo dbaṣro mi+daʕwo. 
Kalá ṭәršké,  u+baṣro zaḥf yo. 
ŭ zux, mṭaylan baṣro!’ 
Omar, ‘Tәmā́m. 
Hawli i+ṣәṭlo’. 
Lwәšle u+fistān, fayišo hiya zalṭoniṯo i+rabane, ŭ ele lwәšle u+fistān, lwәšle u+fistān, azzeyo. 
Ḥәḷḷe lu+k̇ùrrək̇o, kalkaṯi, e, u+ k̇ùrrək̇o ḥaṯnoyo, kalkaṯi u+ruʕyo.   
Omar, ‘Ba!’  
Omar, ‘Ha! 
Ha, oġlәm’. 
Omar,  ‘Mlay i+ṣәṭlayḏe <baṣ...> bәrġәl ŭ baṣro.  
Mlaya bәrġәl ŭ baṣro, ŭ ṭroṯe u+ruʕyawo, ṭroṯe larke’.  
U+ruʕyo salәq, salәq lmalʕal, azzé, mbele li+odayḏe,  ftәḥle u+baġōl,  malwašlele badle mdiḏe. 
Malwašlele qundraye  ḥaṯto, lwәšlele gomlak,  badle, tām  sәmle xud ruḥe lu+ḥaṯno. 
Hánostene u+ruʕyo koṯe lu+bayto, kәmṭe i+ṣәṭlayḏe, koṯe lu+bayto. 
Koḥayro, komoḥe bu+tarʕo, i+aṯto koḥayro hawxa bu+tarʕo, kito bu+tarʕo naqwo kibe haqqa. 
Qrawa  bәqḏole, ŭ i+badlayḏe aʕle ŭ komoḥe bu+tarʕo, koḥayro. 
Әmmo, ‘Ṣabbā́v, abre du+ṣabbavawo, zux me qmu+tarʕayḏi! 
Hay, k̇učәk̇ abre du+k̇učәk̇, lә+gminakfat  ʕal+babe druḥux, koṯat, koṯat, komoḥat bu+tarʕayḏi. 
‘K̇ačé’, omar, ‘Lә+mṣaʕrat,  k̇ačé, pәṫe, ónono, lә+mṣaʕrat, u+zlamáyḏaxno. 
Əmmo, ‘U+zlām’ , bdela ebe baṣ+ṣuʕre. 
Mṣaʕaḷḷale, qayimole. 
‘K̇ačé’ omar, ‘Lә+mṣaʕrat, ónono, húleli badle lu+ḥaṯno, húleli badle, xud druḥe sə́mleli ḥaṯno. 
Húleli badle me druḥe’. 
Hmmm...  ʕAbәr, ʕabәr, šlәḥle mәdle li+qemәstayḏe, hiwole li+ḥurmayḏe, ŭ yatiwi ann+arbʕo+naʕimayḏe ʕal i+ṣәṭlo du+baṣro, du+bәrġәl, di+rezo ŭ xәḷḷe, xәḷḷe. 
Ele ŭ li+aṯto lo+fašše. 
Lan+naʕime ntәšše u+muklo, xәḷḷe, kafínewayne ar+rabana. 
Qām hánostene, mәd hawxa hawi, i+ḥurmayḏe әmmo, ‘Mērk̇o! 
B Ăḷo fayišina ono ŭ hat dlo muklo’. 
Omar, ‘De ḥurma, zax gdobәllax, kalé zaḥfyo, kito zaḥfyo, zax gdobәllax’. 
Azzayo, i+rabane mәdla i+ṣәṭlayḏa, lwәšla u+fistank̇ayḏa ŭ azzá. 
Ḥәḷḷa li+kalo, kalko kuṯyo i+aṯto du+ruʕyo, kuṯyo i+aṯto du+ruʕyo. 
Әmmo,  ‘ʕAmmo!’  
Omar, ‘Ha’. 
Әmmo, ‘ʕAmmo, mlay i+ṣәṭlayḏa bәrġәl ŭ baṣro, di+pirak̇ayo, ŭ ṭro sәlqo larke’. 
Saliqo saliqo, maʕәbrola li+oda, húlala badle ʕayni xud ruḥa, simola xud ruḥa húlala badle. 
Әmmo , ‘Dánnaqqa izáx’. 
Aṯyo, aṯyo, naḥito, mәdla i+ṣәṭlayḏa du+baṣro du+bәrġәlayḏa  mәdla, ŭ aṯyo lu+bayto, aṯyo lu+bayto. 
Lan+naʕime hǧәmme li+ṣәṭlayḏa, ela ŭ lu+zlam tavda matimalle.  
Xәḷḷe ŭ fayiši hawxa, fayiši hawxa.  
ŭ gāh hiya gnәfqo larwal, ŭ gāh hiye gnofaq larwal.  
Komar, ‘Dәnya gáwrək̇a , dәzzino gab i+ḥurmayḏi gmōṯno’. 
ŭ i+žə́nk̇este kәmmo, ‘Doṯe gabi gmayṯono, ma lo, latno ṭaw mine! 
ʕAṣәl híyeyo’. 
Konәfqi ŭ kodәʕri, u+babo koqore me tamo, komar, ‘K̇urem, qay lo+kuzzúx li+odayḏux? 
Lawo, zux li+odayḏux, zux si+ḥurmayḏux, k̇urem’. 
Omar, ‘E, ba, baba, tәmā́m, ṭrowe’. 
Axәr marke ltamhenik̇é,  dʕalle lu+Alohaṯṯe la+tre. 
Əmmi, ‘D Aloho, šupḥo lәšme u+ḥalyo, d Aloho obelan ʕumro, hăma dhowina yašamíš ʕam+ḥḏoḏe kmo+әšne, kmo+әšne dhowina ʕam+ḥḏoḏe yašamíš’. 
Əmmi, ‘Tәmā́m’. 
Dʕalle lu+Alohaṯṯe,  li+žәnk̇e mәḷḷale lu+gawro, əmmo, ‘Mērk̇o!’ 
Omar, ‘Ha’. 
Әmmo, ‘Mērk̇o, gdәmmaḷḷux mede’. 
Omar, ‘Amár’. 
Әmmo, ‘Mērk̇o, d̥saymat bdiḏi gdobinanne falge+dʕәmrayna, gdobinanne falge+dʕәmrayna, lu+ḥaṯno ŭ li+kalo’. 
Omar, ‘Ṭrowe, tәmā́m, Tәmā́m’. 
Hə́nәkste kodoʕәn lu+Alohaṯṯe, kәmmi, ‘Hăma  dhowina yašamíš ʕam+ḥḏoḏe a+kmo+әšne , tavda dmayṯina’. 
Hánostene,  hawi dăráng du+lalyo, konofaq, komar u+babo, ‘K̇urem, qay lo+kuzzúx li+odayḏux?’ 
Komar, ‘Ba, tәmā́m’.
Azzeyo, azzé, ʕabәr, azzé si+ḥurmayḏe. 
‘Hak’, omar, ‘Yawo!’ 
Omar,  ‘Ha’. 
Omar, ‘Yawo, kalé, kalé lo+māṯno, ŭ hatste lo+mayiṯat!’ 
U+maloxo me taḥt i+qaryola  nafәq, u+maloxo nafәq, omar, ‘Lo+mәǧġolat’, omar, ‘Lo+mәǧġolat’, omar. 
Lu+maloxo omar , ‘Lu+baqoro ... lu+ruʕyo  ŭ li+ḥurmayḏe húwallux falge+dʕәmrayye, húwallux falge+dʕәmrayye, tmoni+әšne kәtte ʕәmro,  arbʕi <elux...> də́ṯxune ŭ arbʕi də́ṯṯene. 
Mәd kamili a+tmoni+әšne a+tretayxu tavda gmayṯutu’.  
Hawxa omar, ‘E’. 
Әmmi, ‘Tәmā́m’.  
Maqḏalle  hawxa ʕam+ḥḏoḏe, hūl d̥kamili a+tmoni+әšnaṯṯe, hawәlle  kul ḥa+naʕímestene, kamili  a+tmoni+әšnaṯṯe, ŭ ann+arbʕo bəḥḏo naqqa  mayiṯi b̥ḥa lalyo, mayiṯi ann+arbʕo. 
ŭ tə ṣāġ.

sentences.translation: When the eighty years have finished, the two of you will die all together’.

sentences.translation: He says accordingly, ‘Yes’.

sentences.source_line: Әmmi, ‘Tәmā́m’.
sentences.translation: They say, ‘Fine’.

sentences.source_line: Maqḏalle  hawxa ʕam+ḥḏoḏe, hūl d̥kamili a+tmoni+әšnaṯṯe, hawәlle  kul ḥa+naʕímestene, kamili  a+tmoni+әšnaṯṯe, ŭ ann+arbʕo bəḥḏo naqqa  mayiṯi b̥ḥa lalyo, mayiṯi ann+arbʕo.
sentences.translation: They passed the time with each other like so, until their eighty years finished, each one of them had children as well, their eighty years finished, and the four died at once, in one night, the four died.
